summary.overall_note: This width looks the weakest of the three for genuine semantics: only 1 of 30 sampled features (5558, genomics/sequencing methodology) is convincingly concept-level. The high-frequency band is almost entirely Gandhi/Science slot-filling templates plus the ubiquitous always-on unit (972), and the rarest 'alive' band is dominated by effectively dead single-token features (ten of them) and heterogeneous mixtures. The large count of dead singletons and templates suggests much of the added 8192 capacity went to redundant template/positional and script detectors rather than new coherent concepts.
